content.text: Stripe's availability map covers 46 countries. PayPal's risk engine flags accounts from Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and dozens of other markets before any human review occurs. Gumroad holds payouts for up to 30 days in certain regions. Lemon Squeezy and Paddle are unavailable across most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-minimum-viable-stack|Payment Options]] [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-design-assets-crypto-payments-2|infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. The solution is not finding a workaround inside this system. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/build-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products-until-you|COREMERCH guide to build]]ing on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Fonts online

Stripe's decision not to support Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Kenya, Ethiopia, and dozens of other countries is not a technical limitation — it is a business decision driven by correspondent banking requirements, local regulatory compliance costs, and risk modeling. PayPal operates the same way. The practical result is that a creator in Lagos with a real product, a real audience, and a real income goal is blocked at the infrastructure level before any transaction ever occurs. Understanding this is the first step toward choosing a different architecture. The correct response is not finding a compliant workaround inside the conventional system. It is building on infrastructure that does not require banking partnerships, local regulatory agreements, or platform permission to operate. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails that bypass every one of these constraints.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Gumroad's payout delays, Payhip's withdrawal restrictions, and Lemon Squeezy's geographic unavailability all stem from the same root cause: these platforms operate within the traditional financial system. They process payments through Stripe or PayPal on the backend, which means they inherit every restriction those processors impose. When Stripe does not support your country, Gumroad cannot pay you out — regardless of what the platform's feature list implies. Paddle operates as a merchant of record, which creates additional compliance requirements that make it functionally unavailable in most of Africa, South Asia, and Latin America. These are not platform-level problems. They are financial system problems that only infrastructure built outside that system can solve.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
With sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, you have full control and ownership of the payment process.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

The direct answer is NOWPayments combined with a sovereign commerce stack. NOWPayments is a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 coins, charges 0.5% per transaction, and sends a webhook to your backend the moment payment confirms on-chain. Your backend — a Cloudflare Worker in Stack 02, a Google Apps Script Web App in Stack 01 — receives the webhook, verifies the transaction hash on the blockchain, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the delivery email automatically. There is no platform that can suspend your access, no compliance team that can flag your account, no payout schedule that delays your revenue, and no company that can change the rules on you tomorrow.
Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure provides scalability and flexibility, allowing you to easily add or remove products and configure payment options as needed.

With this solution, you can sell digital products, such as fonts, online without relying on Stripe or other payment processors. Visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for more information.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy sovereign digital commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: (1) deploy a Cloudflare Pages site, (2) set up Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, (3) integrate Supabase for order storage, (4) configure NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and (5) configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC for security and compliance. With these steps, you can deploy a scalable and flexible commerce platform that is not subject to platform restrictions or account suspension.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between sovereign digital commerce infrastructure and traditional payment processors?

Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure provides full control and ownership of the payment process, eliminating platform dependencies and providing scalability and flexibility. Traditional payment processors, on the other hand, often come with high fees, slow payment processing times, and complex payment flows.
Why is sovereign digital commerce infrastructure a better option for digital creators in restricted countries?

Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure provides a permanent, base-layer solution that is not subject to platform restrictions or account suspension. This means that digital creators can operate with confidence, knowing that their payment process is secure and compliant with industry standards.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification?

NOWPayments offers fast payment processing, low fees, and a seamless payment experience. It also supports 300+ cryptocurrencies, making it an attractive option for digital creators who need to accept a wide range of payment options.
How does sovereign digital commerce infrastructure prioritize security and compliance?

Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure prioritizes security and compliance through features such as SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configuration, as well as automatic payment verification and order management. This ensures that digital creators can operate with confidence, knowing that their payment process is secure and compliant with industry standards.
What level of support and maintenance can I expect from sovereign digital commerce infrastructure?

Sovereign digital commerce infrastructure provides 30-day support and maintenance, allowing digital creators to focus on their business, while the infrastructure takes care of payment processing and order management.
Can I deploy sovereign digital commerce infrastructure on my own, or do I need to hire a developer?

You can deploy sovereign digital commerce infrastructure on your own, using tools such as Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. However, if you need help with configuration or customization, you can hire a developer or consult with a professional.
